issues.existing: stone table with a second paper and a small red seal
issues.observed: I recorded one or two small dark objects on the parapet between the figure and the armillary sphere, logged as count null / countConfidence low because I could not separate or identify them. I did not resolve a second sheet of paper, and I did not resolve any red seal.
issues.evidence: The parapet surface to the viewer-right of the figure, between the held letter and the armillary sphere: at this scale and in this light the items there read only as small dark masses. The one sheet I could resolve is the lit one held in the figure's hands.

issues.existing: a potted plant at the lower left
issues.observed: I recorded two planted urns / garden pots, but on the viewer-RIGHT, on and beside the lower parapet behind the figure. At the viewer-left I recorded only the vine trellis, the stone steps and a single upright stone pedestal / small column among the vines — no pot.
issues.evidence: Lower-right quadrant: two upright planted containers sit beside the pentacle parapet, catching the light. Lower-left quadrant: steps, trellis and a slim pedestal shaft. I also recorded in my blind pass that the lower-left quadrant of this image is effectively unreadable, so I cannot assert that nothing is there — hence low confidence rather than a correction.

issues.existing: three golden chalices held aloft and touching
issues.observed: Two goblets, not three. I resolved exactly two bowls, two stems and two feet at the apex, leaning together rim to rim. Four raised forearms converge on them — two hands on the viewer-left goblet and two hands on the viewer-right goblet.
issues.evidence: The apex of the figure group, above all three heads. Enlarged, the silhouette shows one taller/nearer goblet on the viewer-left and one slightly lower goblet on the viewer-right, with four distinct wrists (bangled) gripping them. There is no third bowl, stem or foot anywhere in that cluster, and no occluding mass that could hide one.

issues.existing: raising three golden chalices together beneath a vast nebula sky
issues.observed: The three women raise two goblets between them, four arms meeting at the apex.
issues.evidence: Same apex cluster: three dancers, four raised arms, two goblet bowls.

issues.existing: the three chalices meet at the centre of the upper third, directly beneath the brightest star
issues.observed: Two goblets meet at the centre of the upper third, tilted toward each other and touching rim to rim.
issues.evidence: Apex cluster above the centre figure's head.

issues.existing: small crescent moon at upper left
issues.observed: I recorded several small faint discs scattered in the starfield (upper-left edge, small one right of centre near the top, a faint one at mid-left) but logged countConfidence low, and recorded moonPhase as 'not visible' because none of them reads unambiguously as a phased moon against the nebula.
issues.evidence: Upper-left sky: a pale disc is present, but at this size and against the nebula I could not resolve a terminator, so I cannot confirm 'crescent'. Flagging only that the phase is asserted beyond what I could see — not that the disc is absent.
